exceptions.reason: Corrects the experimental date-input shared-size contract: independent padding/font defaults made compact calendar rows taller than sibling fields. Defaults now use the shared form-control ladder; all existing CSS override names remain supported. Rendered regressions cover six sizes, 24px action targets, theme height overrides, exact-height overrides and three browser engines.
